body: §2–104.2. (a) In this section, “sensitive location” has the meaning stated in § 6–111 of the State Government Article. (b) (1) This subsection does not apply to a State or local correctional facility or a detention facility in a District Court or circuit court house. (2) A public school, a public library, or a unit of the Executive Branch of State or local government that operates at a sensitive location shall deny access to any portion of the sensitive location that is not accessible to the general public to any individual who is seeking access for the purpose of enforcing federal immigration law, unless: (i) the individual presents a valid warrant issued by a federal court; or (ii) exigent circumstances exist.
